name: MonarchInlineErrorRetry
title: InlineErrorRetry
summary: A compact row that says a part of the screen did not load, with a retry button.
whenToUse: Inside a card, a section or a list when one part failed and the rest of the screen works, or as a strip above stale data that is still shown.
whenNotToUse: When a whole screen or region failed, use MonarchErrorState. For a message with no retry, use MonarchInlineNotice.
api: init(_ message: String, systemImage: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .danger, variant: MonarchInlineErrorRetryVariant = .inline, isRetrying: Bool = false, toneLabel: String? = nil, retryLabel: String? = nil, retryingLabel: String? = nil, onRetry: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the SF Symbol of the tone.

options.name: tone
options.description: danger when nothing could load; warning when stale data is still shown.

options.name: variant
options.description: inline is a plain row; banner is a tinted, bordered strip.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Shows the button as busy; its action does not run.

options.name: toneLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name of the tone.

options.name: retryingLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Retrying" announcement and button value.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Runs when the retry button is activated and no retry is in progress.

states.name: failed
states.description: The message and the retry button.

states.name: retrying
states.description: A spinner replaces the icon of the button; "Retrying" is announced once and is the value of the button.

appearance: An icon in the strong colour of the tone and the message in the default text colour. The banner variant adds the subtle fill and the border of the tone with 8-point corners; the inline variant has no surface.
platformNotes: The busy state is always controlled with isRetrying; the web can also track a promise returned by onRetry. The web actions slot (extra actions after the button) and returnFocusTo are not offered: when the row is replaced by content, VoiceOver focus follows the system's rules. Any MonarchTone is accepted, where the web allows danger and warning. Android builds the same component.
accessibility: The icon and the message are one element, read as the tone name, then the message; toneLabel replaces the tone name.
The retry button is a separate element with a touch target of at least 44 points.
When isRetrying changes from false to true, "Retrying" is posted as an announcement.
While isRetrying is true the button stays focusable, does not run its action and has the value "Retrying".
The message and the button stack when they do not fit on one line, so nothing is truncated at large text sizes.
edgeCases: The end of a retry is not announced: the content, or the row again, is what follows.
The neutral tone has no spoken tone name.

examples.title: Inline, with a pending retry
examples.code: MonarchInlineErrorRetry("Your recent payouts didn’t load.", retryLabel: "Try again") {}

examples.title: Above stale data

parityExceptions.reason: The web puts the message and the Try again button on one row, which needs about 400 points; a phone column has 306, so the button drops under the message. The message, the warning icon and the button are the same; the row keeps the web layout whenever it fits.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG: controls wrap under their text when the width runs out instead of shrinking or truncating
